label: post hoc cluster sign-flip permutation test (descriptive sensitivity to McNemar independence)

tierC_siglip2_vs_clip.description: A = SigLIP2-I, B = CLIP-B-I (619 index, paired by query_id)
tierC_siglip2_vs_clip.interpretation_note: McNemar treats the paired cases as independent; cases from the same identity are correlated (identity clusters), so its p-value is anti-conservative. The permutation p flips the sign of whole identity clusters (paired, two-sided) and respects this clustering; it is a post hoc sensitivity check, not a replacement of the preregistered test.
